notes.title: Friday patch!
notes.notes:
Greetings, programs.

Thanks so much for the support everyone, we couldn't be happier with the reaction to our game!

We're putting up a small patch for the weekend. We launched super stable, so all this does is fix an achievement triggering bug on Mac (and prevent it from emerging on PC).

Thanks all, and if you like the game, don't forget to share it with friends and leave a steam review!

notes.title: TRON: Identity has a Gameplay Trailer AND a Release Date!
notes.notes:
>◎//: Message downloading...

Hello!

Last week, we dropped our gameplay trailer for TRON: Identity! We're always so excited to be able to share new content with you, and this was no exception. Not only that, but reading responses and seeing excitement for the game is one of our absolute favourite things.

We've also announced an official release date...

TRON: Identity launches on Steam and Nintendo Switch on APRIL 11!

Catch the trailer below, and as always, remember to WISHLIST!

[previewyoutube=nRKJ9ElRc8s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Greetings, Programs! TRON: Identity now has a release month!
notes.notes:
We were incredibly excited to announce on Wednesday that TRON: Identity will be released in April 2023! 

Along with the announcement, we're also able to share a first look at TRON: Identity's gameplay. We're so grateful for the incredible response from the community, with all your kind words and wishlists.

You can check out TRON: Identity's gameplay trailer and release month announcement below. We can't wait to show you more!

[previewyoutube=Lfc8R6GFF6A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: That Tron visual novel has a release window, a new trailer, and lots of choices to make
notes.notes:
Button up your neon pyjamas, because Tron: Identity has a release window and a new gameplay trailer. Revealed at yesterday's Nintendo Direct, the "narrative puzzle adventure" from Thomas Was Alone and Subsurface Circular creator Mike Bithell will come out sometime in April this year, inviting you to crack open a mystery "In a new Grid, forgotten by its creator and left alone to evolve without User intervention"...
                Read more.
